import { Controller, Injectable, Post } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Column, Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn, Repository } from 'typeorm';
import Redlock from 'redlock';

@Entity('ticket')
class Ticket {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id!: number;

  @Column()
  status!: string;
}

@Injectable()
class TicketData {
  constructor(@InjectRepository(Ticket) private readonly tickets: Repository<Ticket>) {}

  async updateStatus(ticketId: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.tickets.update(ticketId, { status: 'resolved' });
  }
}

@Injectable()
class RedisLockService {
  constructor(private readonly redlock: Redlock) {}

  // CSW0_FLOW:direct-terminal
  async executeWithLock<T>(lockKey: string, task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.redlock.using([lockKey], 5_000, async () => task());
  }

  // CSW0_FLOW:unchanged-forwarding
  async executeWithNttLock<T>(nttId: string, task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return this.executeWithLock(`lock:ntt:${nttId}`, task);
  }
}

@Injectable()
class TicketService {
  constructor(
    private readonly locks: RedisLockService,
    private readonly ticketData: TicketData,
  ) {}

  // CSW0_CASE:direct-wrapper
  async forceResolveTicket(ticketId: string): Promise<string> {
    const ticketData = this.ticketData;
    return this.locks.executeWithLock(`lock:ticket:${ticketId}`, async function () {
      await ticketData.updateStatus(ticketId);
      return 'forced';
    });
  }

  // CSW0_CASE:two-level-wrapper
  async resolveTicket(ticketId: string): Promise<string> {
    return this.locks.executeWithNttLock(ticketId, async () => {
      await this.ticketData.updateStatus(ticketId);
      return this.finalizeResolveTicket(ticketId);
    });
  }

  async finalizeResolveTicket(ticketId: string): Promise<string> {
    return `resolved:${ticketId}`;
  }
}

@Controller('tickets')
class TicketController {
  constructor(private readonly tickets: TicketService) {}

  @Post(':id/resolve')
  resolveTicket(): Promise<string> {
    return this.tickets.resolveTicket('runtime-id');
  }
}

if (Date.now() < 0) {
  throw new Error('CSW0 verified wrapper fixture must never execute');
}
